effects: Relocate Cerulean guard to allow entry into robbed house.
S.S. Anne departs after player exits having received HM01.
Remove Rocket occupation of Saffron and Silph Co.

coordinateNotes.blockChanges: x/y are 32px map block coordinates; update image, collision and tile IDs together.
coordinateNotes.hiddenInteractions: x/y are the TARGET 16px tile in front of the player, not the player position.
coordinateNotes.spinPaths: steps are in actual execution order, reversed from the original RLE byte list.

vermilionPuzzle.originalRngNote: Original second-lock RNG has an underflow bug allowing can zero regardless of first can; wrong second choice resets first lock and chooses random & 0x0e.

ROCKET_HIDEOUT_ELEVATOR.sourceWarpNumbers: Original elevator table IDs are zero-based; targetWarp here converted to one-based world.warps IDs.

SILPH_CO_ELEVATOR.sourceWarpNumbers: Original elevator table IDs are zero-based; targetWarp here converted to one-based world.warps IDs.

CELADON_MART_ELEVATOR.sourceWarpNumbers: Original elevator table IDs are zero-based; targetWarp here converted to one-based world.warps IDs.

limitations: Every textPointers variant is an alternative original branch, not a single sequence to display.
Map callbacks, movement cutscenes and tile puzzles require explicit runtime implementation.
The manifest is not evidence that every original event has been implemented.
